Delivering exceptional customer service, you’ll develop skincare conversations with all your customers, engaging them in our brand journey and increasing product sales in the process.

Promote the unique brand differentiation and the link with the ingredient stories, product benefits and usage.

Notes
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking Commercial Window Cleaner to join our team. This full-time role involves cleaning windows across a variety of commercial buildings and sites, including high-level windows using access equipment. The successful candidate will also provide relief cover for our trailer driver when required.
The role requires an individual who is physically fit, safety-conscious, and capable of working independently while maintaining high standards of workmanship. Duties include cleaning external windows to a professional standard, operating hoist/cherry picker equipment and other access equipment for high-rise buildings, ensuring all work is carried out in accordance with health and safety procedures, reporting any defects or issues identified during cleaning operations, and completing assigned sites within scheduled timeframes.
Applicants must hold a full driving licence and be able to work the required hours of 4:00am to 12:00pm, Monday to Friday. Candidates must be physically fit, comfortable working at heights, and capable of using access equipment safely. Reliability, punctuality, attention to detail, and a positive attitude are essential, along with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

This a full-time permanent position with a consistent 40-hour working week, training and support where required, and the opportunity to work within a professional and supportive team environment.

If you are dependable, motivated, and looking for a rewarding role in a growing business, we would like to hear from you.

To apply, please send your CV and covering letter to hr@prospero.im

Notes
Onchan District Commissioners are seeking a reliable, hardworking and motivated Refuse Operative to join their Environmental Services team.  This is an active, outdoor role that plays a vital part in maintaining the cleanliness and environmental standards of our community.   You will work as part of a team collecting domestic, commercial and public waste throughout the district. You will assist with the safe and efficient operation of refuse collection services while helping to maintain a clean and attractive environment for residents and visitors.  You will be required to wear and maintain the uniform and personal protective equipment provided, ensuring a professional appearance and high standard of service to the public. The role is physically demanding and involves working outdoors in all weather conditions, requiring a flexible approach and a commitment to delivering high standards of public service. Essential Requirements include:  Hold a full and valid driving licence; Being physically fit and capable of undertaking demanding manual work, including lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling wheeled bins, and walking considerable distances throughout the working day; Being comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions and occasionally in challenging environments; Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills; Be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing; Remain calm, professional and effective when working under pressure; Demonstrate a positive, reliable and flexible approach to work;  The ability to work well as part of a team and build positive working relationships with colleagues, residents and other stakeholders.  If you enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering a high-quality public service, and are comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions, we would like to hear from you. For further information and how to apply please use the following link:
https://jobs.exceedoutsourcing.co.uk/jobs/Onchan-District-Commissioners/20081000008852013/General-Labourer---Refuse?source=CareerSite

Working both independently and as part of a team, you will help ensure the district remains clean, safe and welcoming throughout the year.  The role is physically demanding and involves working outdoors in all weather conditions, requiring a flexible approach and a commitment to delivering high standards of public service.  Essential requirements include:  Possess a full clean driving licence including Category C1; have excellent interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to undertake physically demanding outdoor work; possess a basic understanding of health and safety requirements; have a positive, reliable and self-motivated approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team; be physically fit and able to work in all weather conditions. Notes
We are seeking a skilled Customer Care Technician to carry out high-quality remedial and maintenance works within newly completed homes across the Isle of Man.

Please apply here - https://careers.dandara.com/jobs/7893141-customer-care-technician

You will be responsible for carrying out remedial and maintenance works in occupied new homes, ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and to a high standard. The role is critical to delivering excellent customer satisfaction, protecting the company’s reputation, and ensuring homes meet quality and warranty standards.

What you will be doing:

Carry out snagging, remedial, and maintenance works in occupied and newly completed homes.
Diagnose and rectify defects across a range of trades, including basic carpentry, joinery, plumbing, and finishing works.
Respond to customer care issues within agreed service levels and appointment times.
Liaise professionally with homeowners, explaining works clearly and managing expectations.
Work closely with Customer Care Coordinators to plan and prioritise works.
Ensure all works are completed to a high standard and in line with warranty requirements.
Maintain accurate records of works completed, materials used, and follow-on actions required.
Identify defects requiring specialist subcontractor involvement and escalate where appropriate.
Ensure compliance with health & safety policies and procedures at all times.
Maintain tools, materials, and company vehicle in a safe and presentable condition.
Support inspections and quality checks where required.
Promote a positive company image through professional conduct and workmanship.

What you will have:

Proven experience as a Customer Care Technician, Maintenance Technician, or Multi-skilled Tradesperson, ideally within housebuilding or residential construction.
Strong practical skills across multiple trades.
Customer-focused mindset with excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently and manage daily workloads effectively.
High standards of workmanship and attention to detail.
Understanding of new-build defects, warranty standards, and snagging processes.
Full IOM driving licence - Full Driving License is essential to be considered.
Relevant trade qualifications are advantageous but not essential.

What's in it for you:
Competitive salary or hourly rate depending on experience.
Fuelled company van and tools provided.

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

Notes
Reporting to the board of directors the successful applicant will be responsible for Meetings (preparing agendas, taking minutes and maintaining governance records for the Board and Captains Committee - 2 evenings per month), providing management reports, organise, prepare and send out details of AGM/EGM to club members. Another key responsibility will be membership management which will involve seeking to maintain the club’s membership at the required level in order to meet the projected financial requirements, preparing reports on membership trends, marketing performance and acting as a key point of contact for members, visitors and external organisations. 
Also key to this role is Marketing and promoting the club to prospective members, visitors and societies. Duties will include the development of membership recruitment campaigns and special offers, contacting and engaging with potential sponsors of club events, management of social media accounts for the club, website content and email campaigns and to co-ordinate some major events for the club such as Sponsor Days, Charity Days and Corporate Days).
This successful applicant will also be responsible for general duties such as procurement requirements which will assist the running of the club, manage bookings, tee-time administration including the daily supervision of the club’s tee booking system and club communications. The role will involve handling and sharing correspondence, emails and dealing with telephone enquiries. Ensuring compliance with club policies, regulations and governing body requirements is another key responsibility of this role. The position will involve liaising with with Greenkeeping Staff, Golf Professional and the Club’s Catering Partner.
Required skills and competencies for this role include a strong administrative ability, excellent communication and customer service skills as well as competence with office software (Microsoft Office) and membership management systems. Financial awareness is key as well as the ability to work independently and as part of a team. A flexible and proactive approach to work is required. Other desirable experience is a knowledge of golf club operations and competition management, marketing and social media skills, sponsorship and event planning and a familiarity with Sage Accounting system would also be advantageous. The successful applicant will be expected to work closely with the Club Secretary (Administration & Finance) as part of an effective team and develop awareness of the key elements of that role and provide task cover for any periods of absence (holidays and sickness) or peaks in demand. These key elements include membership management, invoice processing, payroll and other financial and general club administration.
Please apply to The Chairman, Peel Golf Club, Rheast Lane, Peel IM5 1BG or by email to secretary@peelgc.com.

#1 Dog Food - eDogAdvisor (over 700 reviews).
”Best Value 5* Food” - AllAboutDogFood.
Business of Distinction Awards.
Highly Commended - Best Dog Food Brand, Your Dog Magazine.
We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Advisor to:
Process orders.
Advise customers in canine & feline nutrition via telephone and e-mail.
Liaise with parcel carriers to ensure efficient delivery.
Contact current and potential stockists.
Deliver orders to local customers in our small electric van (ideal, not required - currently half a day per week).
Attend occasional shows to exhibit our products as and when required. 
Computer skills, spreadsheets, social media platforms, numeracy and literacy should all be second nature to you. You will need to work well under pressure, dealing with challenging customers at times, so a calm manner is required to avoid being anxious about any pressurised situations that may arise from time to time. We are specifically looking for enthusiastic self-motivated team-players with initiative and a fantastic work ethic. With an impeccable telephone manner and passion for pets, your advice will help puppies thrive on our sublime food resulting in glowing customer reviews. If this sounds like you and you love dogs then get in touch today!
The computer systems we are are Zendesk, Magento and Mintsoft so if you have prior experience with any of those then that would help. If you happen to have marketing, sales or IT skills you may also be able to help further in other areas as we grow.
In return we can offer:
A competitive salary.
Potential bonus for exceeding expectations.
Self-study canine nutrition training.
Discounted pet supplies.
Part-time hours.
8:30am - 3pm working hours Monday, Wednesday & Friday with 30 mins unpaid lunch (evenings, weekends & shows optional).
This role is primarily located at our Head Office in Douglas, Isle of Man. There is a relocation incentive of up to £4,400 available, terms apply.
Please submit your CV and covering letter stating why you wish to work for our business in particular. We have keen eyes for the correct usage of the English language so please use correct grammar and spelling. CVs submitted without covering letters will not be read.

Delivery Driver's play a crucial part of the team within GSF Car Parts. They are the face of our brand by delivering parts to customers and continuously providing excellent customer service. Our Delivery Drivers are important to us, giving customer feedback insights and ensuring we stay committed to delivering goods within the promised time. 
 
As a Delivery Driver, you will be responsible for contributing to overall success of a high performing organisation and promoting the Company brand through positive interaction with customers.

Main Duties include:

Delivering product to customer’s premises within a 40 mile radius.
Ensure high levels of customer service at all times.
Feedback to branch on relevant customer and competitor activity.
Load your vehicle according to procedures.
Collect customer returns as required.
Vehicle maintenance including carrying out daily checks.
Help in the warehouse as and when required.
Assist with Inter-Branch Transfer Deliveries as and when required.
Working hours:

41 (average) hours Monday to Friday, including alternate Saturday working.

What you'll need to succeed:

Must hold a full UK Driving Licence with a maximum of 6 points.
Must have a minimum of 3 years driving experience.
Excellent knowledge of 40 mile radius of branch.
Previous experience within a delivery driver role.
Ability to understand necessity of excellent standards of customer service.
Work to deadlines with good time keeping skills.
Customer focused, driven to achieve and willing to go the extra mile.

Benefits at GSF Car Parts are designed to support all aspects of our team members life throughout their career. Whether that’s their health, wealth or everyday lifestyle, we are here for our team members and their loved ones and there is something for everyone! To name a few of our benefits we offer:

28 days annual leave (including bank holidays) plus the opportunity to earn up to 5 more with time-served.
Free flu vaccine.
Health & wellbeing tools.
Free support from pension experts .
Life assurance scheme.
Discounts from 100’s of household names including Asda, Nike & John Lewis.
A suite of financial wellbeing products including advances and savings schemes. 
Paid time off to volunteer.
Training qualifications and career progression opportunities.

As a Delivery Driver and Warehouse Operative at Pacesetter, you will be primarily responsible for delivering orders to sites across the Isle of Man in a timely and professional manner. You will plan and organise your delivery routes efficiently to make the most of each working day, and ensure that all deliveries are correct and complete against the relevant paperwork. Back at the warehouse, you will unload incoming stock, inspect items for damage and allocate them to the correct orders, as well as providing general support across warehouse operations as needed.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must be aged 18 or over and hold a full driving licence, as this is central to the role. We are looking for someone with a positive work history and a strong record of reliable attendance. While not essential, knowledge of tiles or bathroom materials would be an advantage, as would holding a forklift licence. Above all, we are looking for someone dependable, organised and happy to turn their hand to whatever the day requires.

To find out more or to apply, please contact us by phone on 01624 622045 or by email at dan@pacesetter-ltd.com. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Level 3 Practitioner – Dragonflies Nursery, Ramsey
We're looking for an enthusiastic Level 3 Early Years practitioner to join our team at Dragonflies Nursery in the heart of Ramsey. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a growing, purpose-built setting dedicated to creating a nurturing and enriching environment for children.
The ideal candidate will hold a Level 3 qualification in Early Years Education, have a genuine passion for working with young children, and bring a reliable, positive attitude to everything they do.
In return, we offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience, real opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive team who care deeply about the children in their care. You'll be joining a setting that's going from strength to strength, where your contribution genuinely matters.
To apply, send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you'd be a great fit. If you haven't heard back within two weeks, please assume your application was unsuccessful. All offers are subject to DBS and relevant security checks.
We can't wait to hear from you.

For more information and to apply please contact shondelle@grasshoppers.im

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team.

The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times.

Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 2 and 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience.

Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position.

Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities.

Why Join Prospero Group?

We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave.  Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us.

To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Notes
Swagelok Ltd. 
Tool Maker.
We are Hiring!
We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift.
Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday).
Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding).
We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.
The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience:
Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements:
Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You:
This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.
To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Swagelok Ltd.
Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.
The roll can be physical demanding and an applicant must be capable of being on their feet for up to 8- hours a day. Lift, push, pull or carry weight no more than 35lbs, as well as squat bend and reach.
This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.
If you are interested in applying for this role, please visit our online portal at http://iomjobs.Swagelok.com

We’re seeking a Senior Administrator with regulatory reporting experience to join our Retail Operations Reporting team, specialising in Automatic Exchange of Information (AEI) reporting (CRS, FATCA). In this role, you’ll combine technical expertise with oversight of reporting delivery, controls, and change, ensuring all regulatory reporting is accurate, timely, and compliant.
You’ll take ownership of the end-to-end AEI reporting process, support complex cases, and act as a key contact for stakeholders, Compliance, and audit queries. Alongside this, you’ll help maintain high standards of control and quality, meeting strict deadlines while identifying risks and improving processes. You’ll also contribute to regulatory change initiatives, translating requirements into practical solutions and supporting implementation, testing, and team development.
This role is ideal for someone experienced in financial services, regulatory or tax reporting, who is comfortable working with complex data, controls, and regulations. Experience with AEI is advantageous, but not essential if you have a strong foundation in a similar environment and are eager to develop your expertise. Strong Excel skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, regulated environment are key to success.

Please follow the link below to apply:

Key Responsibilities: Overseeing a team, including collaborating with key stakeholders outside of the Finance department, to ensure effective resolution of reconciling items. This includes: IT and Operations, liaising with third party suppliers and finance teams across the Group. Producing balance sheet reconciliations and ensuring unusual discrepancies are resolved in a timely manner or escalated to senior management, as applicable. Contributing to and leading the launch of new automated initiatives, including purchase and sales ledger systems, RPAs, data-analysis tools. Compiling, maintaining and updating the reconciliation matrix to ensure that all critical reconciliations are identified and performed in the Group. Reviewing reconciliations prepared by others, querying the allocation and posting of outstanding and reconciled items. Training members within the team, upskilling individuals to develop their reconciliation skills. Adhering to the month-end timetable to ensure that reconciliations are completed by. Journal posting and month-end reporting activities. Ensuring compliance with internal controls and applicable accounting framework. Processing and timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Participating in adhoc projects as required. Maintain awareness and comply with all anti-money laundering legislation, regulations, policies and procedures relevant to the Group. Comply with all policies and procedures relevant to the role. Key Skills and Experience: Part qualified accountant or actively studying towards an accounting qualification or previous relevant work experience. Excellent excel and numeracy skills. Attention to detail. Excellent communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Knowledge of ERP systems (preferably SUN and Xero).

An opportunity has arisen for a Trainee Accountant within our Finance Team. 

A career as a Trainee Accountant with IFGL will give you the opportunity to join a successful and fast growing company based in the Isle of Man.  With assets of US$27bn and around 600 staff employed worldwide, IFGL is one of the largest employers in the Isle of Man and represents a great opportunity for candidates looking to pursue a career in financial services.

The successful candidate can expect to:
Join a Finance team of around 60 people.
Be part of one of our financial reporting teams.
Expand their experience through rotations between the various teams over the course of their training period. 

The successful candidate will study the ACCA accounting qualification.  We provide a comprehensive study package, which includes access to external training material and study leave.   It will take approximately 3-4 years to obtain your qualification if exams are passed at the first attempt.   

Salary increments will be awarded as you progress through the examinations and take on more responsibility.

Candidates must meet at least one of the following requirements:
Educated to A-Level standard, graded A*- C (preferably one A-Level in Maths, Economics, or Business Studies).
Hold or be on track for at least a 2.1 in your degree.
Experience working in a Financial Services company within a Finance team (E.g. reporting/payments).

Key skills needed to be successful in this role are:
Ability to plan and organise work to meet deadlines. 
Good problem solving and team working skills. 
Able to use initiative and be diligent.
A good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word.
Good numerical skills and the ability to analyse data.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Familiarity with the ACCA qualification.
If you, or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward your current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 
We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

The closing date for this vacancy will be 10 July 2026.

To thrive in a constantly changing world, everyone at PwC is encouraged to be an authentic and inclusive leader, supported by the PwC Professional leadership framework, which sets clear expectations to help individuals succeed and grow. Company Description:
Trilogy Limited offers tailored services in VAT and Customs advice, import/export planning, customs representation, accounting, bookkeeping, yacht and aircraft fiscal management, project management, ownership structuring advice, registration, financing support, international registry representation, and family office support. Operating with integrity and efficiency, we aim to add value to our clients' businesses.

Role Description:
Trilogy Limited is currently seeking a part-time Bookkeeper.  Based in Douglas, with flexibility for some remote work, the successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records, daily posting of invoices, reconciling bank statements and accounts, assisting with month end and quarter end reporting and supporting the team with ad-hoc tasks, contributing to the overall success and continued growth of the company.

Requirements:
Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
Proven bookkeeping experience .
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Proficiency in Quickbooks would be an advantage, but not essential.
Prior experience in a similar role within the Yachting & Aviation sector would be an advantage, but not essential.

What we offer:
Part-time hours: we are looking for someone to work 25-30 hours per week (typically between 9.30am-3.30pm Monday to Friday).
Competitive remuneration package including free parking and non-contributory pension scheme.

Interested?
Please send your CV and a cover email addressed to Fiona at hr@trilogy.im

Notes
About to Graduate?  
Finishing your PhD?
What Next?

From small businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands, our clients count on reliable financial statements, information and processes to inform their ongoing strategies. More than ever, business is about interpreting and reacting to complex data — and they look to us for advice and services they can trust every time. You’ll use your professional skills and experience to make it happen, handling complex audit procedures across the UKI industry sectors.

At EY in the Isle of Man, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.  

The opportunity:
EY’s practice in the Isle of Man is experiencing significant growth. Based in the heart of the Isle of Man, our UKI operation has enjoyed major business wins. With a huge welcome from our clients and increased demand from the UKI industry sectors, the Isle of Man is looking to recruit Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountants starting in August 2026.  

As an Graduate Trainee Chartered Accountant in the Isle of Man, you will be a fundamental part of a multi-disciplinary team, working closely with our clients delivering efficient and effective assurance services. What's more you won't always find yourself in a purely office-based role, as we encourage you to work with clients on their own sites when this is practical and efficient. If you are a confident team player, have excellent communications skills, and have a genuine interest in studying towards an accountancy qualification, consider EY.

Your key responsibilities:
You will be expected to execute work efficiently, delivering excellent service and bringing the full breadth of EY's capability to support our UKI industry sector clients. You will train towards obtaining your ACA professional qualification in a supportive and enthusiastic environment.

Preparing accurate assurance documentation for review.
Take ownership for nominated audit area(s) and/or delivery and completion of smaller clients.
Gaining an in-depth knowledge of the audit process to develop knowledge.
Complete work allocated by direct supervisor within budget and deadlines.
Gain knowledge on engagements of client/business issues, e.g. by using the firm's knowledge resources.
Gather and analyse data, and perform detailed audit testing.

Skills and attributes for success:
Strong motivation to study towards the ICAEW ACA qualification.

To qualify for the role you must have:
2:1 honours degree in any discipline.

We are seeking friendly and resilient Additional Support Workers to join us across all our services. We have over 9 different houses located both in Eastern and Central parts of the Island where they are located within easy reach of local bus routes. You will be joining a friendly, established team that provides quality support to autistic adults.

We are looking for people who will bring their passion and enthusiasm to the role. Autism Initiatives provide specialist support for people with autism and we are committed to working in partnership to achieve the best possible outcomes.

As an Additional Support Worker you will support with a range of activities which meet the wishes of the people that we support and encourages people with autism to live as independently as possible and be part of their local community. The role of an Additional Support Worker enables you to accept shifts around your availability and other commitments. If you are looking for some variety, flexibility in hours and are keen to make a difference, please get in touch today!

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

Notes
Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

For those considering relocation, we offer full support with moving to the Isle of Man, helping to make the transition as smooth and stress-free as possible so you can focus on settling into both your new role and your new home.

Looking for a better work–life balance?

We offer a genuinely flexible approach to working patterns and welcome both full-time and part-time applicants. The full-time role is 38 hours per week, worked over 4 or 5 days, with 1 in 4 Saturday mornings and approximately 1 in 10 nights and weekends on call. Work–life balance is a genuine priority here. You’ll benefit from a competitive salary, generous holiday allowance, and strong CPD support to help you continue developing your equine interests and expertise. Our flexible rota patterns are designed to work around real life — whether that’s school commitments, reduced hours during holidays, or a working pattern that better suits your lifestyle, we’re happy to fix or flex rotas wherever possible. 

Team & Facilities:

You’ll be joining a supportive, friendly and experienced team that values collaboration, mentorship, and a positive working culture. The wider clinical team includes 17 Veterinary Surgeons, 14 Registered Veterinary Nurses, and 20 dedicated support staff, with BVRA-registered members and certificate holders within the group. This equine-only role offers a varied and rewarding caseload, combining ambulatory work in the field with access to excellent facilities and modern diagnostic equipment, enabling you to practice high-quality, progressive equine medicine. You’ll be supported by a knowledgeable team and a learning-focused environment where professional development is actively encouraged and your ideas are valued.

Life on the Isle of Man:

Set against a backdrop of rolling hills, rugged coastlines, and open countryside, the Isle of Man offers a truly special way of life. You’ll become part of a welcoming, close-knit community with a vibrant cultural scene — from the world-famous TT races and music festivals to live shows, local breweries, and a thriving food scene. With endless opportunities for outdoor pursuits, including equestrian activities, cycling, wild swimming, and fitness, it’s easy to build a life here that’s as fulfilling outside of work as it is within it.

Apply via the IVC website or contact taylor.findlay@ivcevidensia.com

Able Homecare Limited is looking to recruit caring, compassionate, and reliable individuals to join our team as Overnight Community Support Workers. This rewarding role involves providing support to adults within their own homes during the night, helping them to remain safe, comfortable, and independent. Duties may include assisting with personal care, supporting mobility, administering or prompting medication where required, monitoring wellbeing, responding to individual needs, and providing reassurance and companionship.

We are seeking individuals who have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and a genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others. Previous care experience would be beneficial but is not essential, as full training and ongoing support will be provided. Applicants should be able to work independently, demonstrate reliability and professionalism, and be committed to delivering high-quality person-centred care.

In return, we offer competitive rates of pay, opportunities for career development and the opportunity to be part of a supportive and dedicated team.

Successful applicants will be subject to satisfactory references and an Enhanced DBS check. 

To apply contact Teresa Boardman on 07624435984.

Notes
Senior support worker:
The purpose of the role is to guide and support the support worker team to meet the needs of the individual service user while promoting and maintaining independence and ensuring all duties are carried out in a person-centred way. To support the team, modelling good practice and promoting positive attitudes. To support the management to meet excellent standards of care delivery.
Supporting people in various areas of identified need, including; Mental Health, wellbeing and emotions, Physical health, medication needs, hygiene routine, communication, daily living skills, quality of life and activities, relationships, education and employment, finances and budgets, dependency needs, community safety, legal matters and housing support. Staff must be motivated, sensible, flexible in their ways of working and have empathy for others. 
The Senior Support worker should have/or be completing Level 3 RQF in health and social care (or equivalent) and 2 years’ experience working with people with complex needs. Applicants who have level 2 RQF and more than 3 years’ experience may also be considered.
The service works on a shift basis with occasional sleep-in shifts and weekend work. Sleep-in shifts are paid additionally at £50 per night. 
Typical hours may include: 
Early day = 08:00 - 16:00. 
Late day = 12:00 – 20:00
Late sleep and early = 12:00 – 22:00 – sleep-in, then 08:00 – 13:00. 

We can offer, contracted 37.5 hours per week, excellent rates of pay = £14.40 per hour. 25 days annual leave plus any bank holidays worked. 8 week rolling rota (issued 2 months in advance). Excellent training opportunities. A great work environment with a fantastic team.
If successful, the candidate will need to have a DBS check completed by Viva Heights and two satisfactory references prior to starting work. A full induction will be given and a period of shadowing will be offered and form part of a 6 month probation period.
Please email Helen Millar on managervivaheights@vivavest.uk with a copy of your CV and to request an application form.

The Bar Worker is responsible for delivering friendly, efficient service to customers while preparing and serving drinks to company standards. The role supports a clean, safe, and welcoming pub environment.

We’re looking for friendly and reliable people to join our bar teams across various Heron & Brearley pubs on the island. We have roles available in both wet-led pubs and pubs that also serve food. No experience is needed as full training is provided. 

Applicants must be 18 or over due to alcohol service.

What the job involves:

Serving drinks and looking after customers.
Supporting food service where required.
Keeping the bar area clean and safe.
Handling payments and using tills.
Working as part of a team during busy shifts. 
Working hours. 

Shift work, including evenings and weekends. Hours vary by site.

What we’re looking for:

Friendly and approachable attitude.
Good communication skills.
Reliability and good timekeeping.
Ability to stay calm when it’s busy.
Willingness to learn and help out where needed. 
Training provided. 

You’ll receive full training in bar service, customer service, responsible alcohol service, and food hygiene where relevant.

Locations: 

Positions are available across multiple Heron & Brearley pubs around the Isle of Man.

Team Role - Barista.

We're Costa, the nation's favourite coffee shop brand, pouring our heart and soul into everything we do and creating moments to remember for our customers, our communities and for each other. Together we turn sips into smiles, choices into opportunities and passions into careers. Help us spread a little happiness. 
About the role – Barista: As a Barista, naturally you'll be serving expertly crafted coffee, but at Costa there's more to the role than that. 
You'll be creating moments that linger and experiences that last. It takes a little crafting, testing and fine-tuning to get it spot on, but with your zest for life, flexible approach and ability to read our customers, you'll soon find yourself delivering coffee experiences that are simply unbeatable. 
The right candidate must be Barista trained and have knowledge of Costa and its brand standards. 

What we Offer You: 
Free Parking.
Free meals.
Free Uniform.
‘Employee Assistance Programme’ provided to all employees.
Wage enhancement for working between 05.30-07.30am - an extra £2 per hour. 
Please apply in writing and include a CV, and email it to iomcosta@caterleisure.co.uk - 

Vacancies will be advertised for 1 month. If you do not hear from us after 1 month, please assume your application has been unsuccessful.

Notes
We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member.
South of the Island.

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role:
Position: Front of House (FOH).
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends).
Pay: Minimum wage.
Location: South of the island.
What You'll Be Doing:
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe.
Greet, assist and seat guests.
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH).
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food).
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards.
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals.
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service.
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service.
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed.
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers.
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation.
Filing of delivery notes and invoices.
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items.
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies.
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required.
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback.
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling.
Always maintain a professional appearance.
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners.
About You:
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred.
Own reliable transport is essential.
Warm, friendly and customer-focused.
Reliable, punctual and well-presented.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team.
Good communication skills and a positive attitude.
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends.
What We Offer:
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment.
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster.
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.
How to Apply:
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im

We are delighted to announce an exciting internal opportunity for an Events Supervisor to join our Food & Beverage team at Comis Hotel & Golf Resort.

This role is ideal for a motivated and experienced individual who is passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences and has a strong interest in weddings, conferences, corporate functions, and special events.

Position Details:

Job Title: Events Supervisor.
Department: Food & Beverage.
Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent.
Start Date: As soon as possible.

About the Role:

As Events Supervisor, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of weddings, conferences, corporate events, and private functions across the resort. You will support the Events and F&B management teams by leading service operations, coordinating event execution, and ensuring our guests receive outstanding service at every stage of their event.

Key Responsibilities:

Supervise and lead event service teams during weddings, conferences, and other functions.
Ensure events are delivered efficiently and to the highest service standards.
Assist with event set-up, room preparation, and operational planning.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure seamless event delivery.
Act as a point of contact for clients and suppliers during events.
Support the training, development, and motivation of team members.
Maintain exceptional guest satisfaction and promptly resolve any operational issues.

Skills and Experience:

We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate:

Previous supervisory experience within hospitality, events, food and beverage, or a customer-focused environment.
Excellent communication and organisational skills.
Strong leadership abilities and a positive, proactive attitude.
The ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays as required by the business.
A commitment to delivering outstanding customer service.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career within Comis Hotel & Golf Resort, gain valuable leadership experience, and contribute to some of the Island's most prestigious events and celebrations.

How to Apply:

If you are interested in this opportunity, please submit your expression of interest and an up-to-date CV to hr@comishotel.com.

Taste Buds has been established for 40 years and provides delicious, high-quality home cooked fresh foods, coffee and outside catering services from our friendly, family run Douglas Sandwich Bar, Kitchen and Shop.
We are looking for a Baker / Customer server to join our small team who has a cheerful and welcoming personality. We start early and finish early which is great, as you have the rest of the day to yourself. The job would be ideal for someone who loves cooking, helping customers and enjoys variety in their work. If this sounds like you, join us and become part of the family.   

Your role will be to prepare our daily Croissants, Home Made Cakes in our kitchen in the mornings, alongside our team, serve our lovely customers with their lunches at lunchtime and clearing after service. Home Made Cake baking experience will be particulary welcomed. Working hours to be mutually agreed will be around 6.30 / 7.00 am to 3.00 pm (Mon – Fri), approx. 38 hours p.w. This is a Monday – Friday permanent day time role (i.e. non-seasonal).

An excellent standard and understanding of verbal and written English is required to enable instructions from customers to be completed accurately. 

We would welcome applications from experienced individuals, however we can also train you in any areas required. Barista experience, telephone experience and a full driving licence would be welcomed. 

Our business is geared to the corporate market and therefore our food must always go out on time, which means we need 100% reliability with your time keeping and attendance. You’ll be bright, smart, professional and clean in your appearance.  Please do not apply if your time keeping or attendance will not be 100% reliable due to personal or health reasons. We are a non-smoking food company and therefore you are not allowed to smoke during working hours.
   
To apply, please either e-mail your CV to callum@tastebuds.im, or pop into the shop – Taste Buds, 5 – 6 Railway Shops, Peel Road, Douglas to collect a job application form. If you would like to know more about the role, please telephone Callum on 615516 after 2.00 pm. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, please assume your application has not been successful.

We are looking for a Trainee IT & Print Engineer to join our team and develop a career within IT, print technology and technical services. This is a varied, hands-on role that offers the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals whilst gaining valuable technical skills and industry-recognised training.

No previous engineering experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in technology.

What you will be doing:

Preparing and configuring printers and other devices before customer installation.
Delivering and installing equipment across the Isle of Man.
Supporting toner and consumables management for customers.
Assisting with the preparation and deployment of laptops and Apple devices.
Receiving, checking and organising stock within the warehouse.
Supporting inventory control and stocktake activities.
Learning our service desk and ticket management systems.
Providing excellent customer service both on-site and over the phone.

Typical working hours are a 37.5-hour week Monday to Friday.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
A keen interest in IT and technology.
Good practical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally a full driving licence.

What we offer:

Full training and ongoing support.
Manufacturer training with leading technology providers.
Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

This role would suit a college leaver, someone looking to start a career in IT or engineering, or an individual with customer service or technical experience who is looking for a new challenge.

Data Engineer (12 Month FTC). Our banking client is delivering a regulatory driven compensation project requiring immediate support within their data and operations function. The role will focus on extracting, cleansing and structuring data from multiple internal systems to support a live claims and customer contact process. This data will be used by operational teams within a CRM system to manage customer outreach and payment activity. This is a hands-on role working closely with operations, customer service and IT stakeholders to ensure data is accurate, complete and fit for purpose in a time sensitive environment. Key responsibilities: Extract and consolidate data from multiple internal systems. Cleanse, validate and structure datasets for operational use. Prepare and format data for upload into CRM and case management systems. Support data requirements linked to compensation activity. Work closely with operations, customer service and IT teams. Investigate and resolve data quality issues. Ensure data integrity for customer contact and payment processes. Key Skills & Experience: Strong hands on experience working with data in a banking or financial services environment. Experience with data extraction, transformation or integration work. Good understanding of databases, spreadsheets, data manipulation or ETL processes. Experience working with CRM or operational systems. Advantageous: Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage volume and deadlines.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16615

This role offers the chance to champion low-code platforms, mentor colleagues, and shape technical strategy across the organisation. The ideal candidate will bring deep application expertise, a passion for automation and low-code innovation, and the confidence to lead technical direction across teams. Key Responsibilities: Act as the senior technical SME and trusted specialist for applications across the Group. Analyse complex business and customer problems and design fit-for-purpose technical solutions. Lead technical analysis, impact assessments and root cause investigations for incidents and change. Oversee and support the implementation of complex technical solutions with expert guidance. Ensure specialist solutions align with Group technology direction through stakeholder engagement. Contribute to the development of technical strategy, standards and best practice. Mentor and coach colleagues, building technical capability and maturity. Foster innovation and influence future ways of working through thought leadership. Key Skills and Experience: Strong technical expertise across core banking and digital platforms. Experience with Internet Banking (.NET), iOS and Android mobile apps, Microsoft Dynamics 365. Proficiency with Power Platform and RPA tooling for automation solutions. Experience acting as an Application SME with deep understanding of system architecture. Knowledge of integrations, data flows, dependencies and system limitations. Experience designing event-driven data solutions and configuring Kafka topics. Proven ability to translate business requirements into clear technical designs.Experience as the specialist for third-party SaaS and low-code tools driving adoption. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to recommend secure, scalable solutions. Experience modernising legacy technologies with supported enterprise solutions (desirable). Exposure to Java or Python in context of event streaming or API integration (desirable). Familiarity with data visualisation, dashboards or AI-enabled tooling (desirable).

As Principal Network Architect at Stacuity, you will be the senior design authority for our global IP network – the underlying connectivity fabric that carries traffic between our mobile core, our edge sites, and our customers and partners worldwide.
This is a role for someone equally comfortable at the whiteboard and in the rack. You will author the High-Level and Low-Level Designs that turn business and customer requirements into resilient, ultra-high-availability network infrastructure, and you will then roll your sleeves up and work alongside our engineers to see those designs through to live deployment. You will be the technical authority other engineers turn to when something needs to be designed right the first time, and the person who steps in when something needs fixing fast.
You will work across our global footprint of edge sites, data centres, and interconnects, with direct responsibility for routing, switching, and firewall architecture, and close involvement in how our network integrates with cloud and core platform infrastructure.

You will be responsible for design and architecture, hands on delivery alongside engineers and the wider infrastructure team and providing technical leadership and mentorship to network and infrastructure engineers.

Notes
As a Senior Test Analyst, you’ll be planning & managing the testing of key BAU workstreams and projects, coordinating with external vendors and internal stakeholders to ensure releases run smoothly and are delivered on schedule. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software testing and develop your leadership, technical and analytical skills.

The main duties for this role are:

Designing and executing functional and regression tests that ensure comprehensive coverage and quality.
Collaborating with change teams (BA/PM), development, and the business, to align testing with business & project objectives. 
Identifying, planning and implementing the test approach across BAU and project workstreams, while adhering to departmental standards & release deadlines. 
Monitoring estimates against actuals, escalating potential slippage and providing workable options for mitigation. 
Monitoring and reporting on test results, creating & maintaining reporting dashboards, and producing completion reports for stakeholder approval.
Adhering to testing strategy, processes & procedures to facilitate governance. Maintaining accurate documentation and artefacts for audit and governance purposes. 
Designing, maintaining re-useable regression tests following internal standards, supporting test execution where needed to ensure deadlines are achieved. 
Developing own knowledge of automation technology and practice, to facilitate a shift-left/automation first approach.
Coordination & support of UAT/BVT testing activities. 
Performance management, training & and support of direct reports.

To ensure that this role is carried out to the desired level, the successful candidate should have the following skills and experience:

Excellent understanding of testing principles, techniques and methodologies.
Strong analytical & problem-solving skills, attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Excellent communication, collaboration & leadership skills.
Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines.
Experience with using Gherkin syntax for test case design.
ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing.
Minimum 3 years of testing experience.
Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular, is an advantage.
Experience of test automation is an advantage.
Experience in people management is an advantage, although training will be given to the right candidate.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds because we embrace diversity and inclusivity within our business.

Closing date for this vacancy will be 10 July 2026.

Job Summary:

Responsible for administering a portfolio of client companies and trusts, ensuring all work is completed accurately, professionally and in accordance with regulatory requirements. Supporting the Client Portfolio Manager, supervising administrative workloads and maintaining strong client relationships.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage the day-to-day administration of client companies and trusts.
Respond to existing and new client enquiries, providing support and quotations where required.
Ensure compliance with AML, KYC and due diligence requirements.
Incorporate companies, establish trusts and prepare all related documentation.
Maintain statutory records, prepare annual returns, AGM documentation and company resolutions.
Process changes to company structures, including director appointments, share transfers and company name changes.
Open and administer client bank accounts and process banking instructions.
Review contracts and agreements, preparing supporting minutes and resolutions.
Monitor filing, tax and compliance deadlines to ensure obligations are met.
Prepare client documentation, including Powers of Attorney, Certificates of Good Standing and legalised documents.
Maintain accurate client records, billing information and time recording systems.
Liaise with clients, regulators, financial institutions and internal departments to deliver an efficient, professional service.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of company procedures, corporate services and regulatory requirements.

Notes
Our client seeks a Transaction Management Unit Manager to join their team. Role Profile: To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients. Key Responsibilities: Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk. Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases. Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations. Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral. Create complex transactions based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Educated to Degree Level (Business Commerce). 5 - 7 years experience in Operations. A track record adding value and delivering professional, client centric service to internal and /or external clients preferred. Experience working within Transaction Management in Financial Services supporting the Investment Banking business.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16599

Job Purpose:	
We’re looking for a confident Digital Marketing Executive that will take the reins of key marketing activity across partner, customer and internal comms for a 12-month fixed term role, helping shape how plan.com shows up in the market every day.

This role is all about turning ideas into impact. From campaigns and content to product launches and partner activity, you’ll be right at the centre of making things happen - creating marketing that gets seen, used and talked about. The ideal candidate will have experience in a high-pace, competitive environment, with the passion and drive to deliver multiple projects often to tight deadlines. A creative and strategic thinker, you’ll have the energy and drive to go the extra mile and exceed expectations.

Working closely with sales, product, design, people experience and senior leaders, you’ll take business priorities and turn them into clear, creative and commercially focused marketing across every channel. It’s a hands-on role where no two days look the same - one minute you’re shaping a campaign, the next you’re pulling together a launch, writing content, or bringing a new idea to life.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
Partner Marketing:
Responsible for the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns to engage audiences and set plan.com apart. 
Lead partner marketing campaigns and enablement activity. 
Develop and maintain sales collateral, partner tools and presentation.
Create partner training materials and enablement content.
Support development of case studies and testimonials.
Coordinate partner webinar communications and setup.

Campaign & Content Delivery:
Plan and deliver marketing campaigns across email, web and digital channels.
Develop and manage end-to-end marketing launch plans for products, services, and platform updates.
Manage customer lifecycle communications including onboarding, service updates, and change communications (from copy through to delivery).

Internal Marketing & Brand:
Ensure brand and messaging consistency across all channels.
Coordinate internal launch planning and go-to-market activity.
Support sales teams with battlecards, messaging, and pitch content.
Coordinate the advertising and PR efforts of the businesses.
Coordinate marketing briefs with internal teams and external agencies (design and PR) where required.
Support maintenance of sales SRM onboarding and data coordination.

Full details of role & how to apply at - www.plan.com/careers

Notes
About MayFly Entertainment.
MayFly Entertainment is a licensed gambling operator regulated by the Isle of Man Gambling Supervision Commission (GSC). With over 10 years of licensing, we provide online sports betting and casino services, maintaining high standards of integrity, transparency, and player protection. Join us in a fast-paced, global industry where you’ll collaborate with experts, tackle complex challenges, and help shape the future of gaming.
Purpose of role:
As DMLRO, you will support the MLRO in ensuring compliance with AML, CFT, and regulatory requirements. You will play a key role in investigating suspicious activity, maintaining effective controls, and deputising for the MLRO when required.
Responsibilities:
You will review and investigate internal suspicious activity reports and support decisions on external reporting, while preparing and submitting high-quality SARs in a timely manner. Acting as a key contact for AML queries and escalations, you will monitor transaction alerts, source of funds, and unusual activity, as well as oversee sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening. The role includes maintaining accurate investigation records, supporting the development and improvement of AML, CFT, and CPF frameworks, and providing guidance on CDD and EDD, including complex cases. You will support regulatory audits, reporting obligations, and external engagement, while also conducting AML monitoring, quality assurance reviews, and control testing to identify weaknesses and drive improvements. In addition, you will deliver AML/CFT training, promote a strong compliance culture, and represent the business at relevant industry events.
Skills & Experience:
You will have strong AML/CFT knowledge within a regulated environment, ideally in the Isle of Man, along with experience in a DMLRO, MLRO, or senior compliance role. Proven experience handling SARs, investigations, and regulatory reporting is essential, along with strong analytical, investigative, and decision-making skills. Excellent written communication and the ability to work independently are required. Experience in eGaming or financial services is highly desirable, and professional qualifications such as ACAMS or ICA are advantageous.
How to Apply:
Please apply by sending your CV via email to: recruitment@mayflyentertainment.com

Our client seeks an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Quality Assurance Analyst to join their team. You will play a crucial role in defining and maintaining Anti-Money Laundering and Combatting Financing of Terror (AML/CFT) Quality Assurance frameworks. This is your opportunity to work alongside motivated professionals, while contributing to meaningful regulatory compliance and risk mitigation. Experience in quality assurance or audit with demonstrated ability to conduct qualitative assessments. Experience in oversight roles related to AML/CFT analytics. Background in Anti-Fraud, Anti-Bribery, Anti-Market Abuse, Anti-Money Laundering and CFT Surveillance. Strong stakeholder management skills across various internal and external levels.

Conduct comprehensive CDD/KYC for higher-risk clients, including complex corporate and trust structures. Validate Source of Funds/Source of Wealth and review AML concession requests. Manage ongoing monitoring, including transaction monitoring tools and risk-based periodic reviews. Deliver AML training, support accreditation programmes, and provide day-to-day operational guidance. Key Skills & Experience: 5+ years' experience in regulated financial services; investment industry experience advantageous. Strong knowledge of Isle of Man AML/CFT legislation, regulation, and guidance. Expertise in analysing complex structures and delivering enhanced due diligence. Proven ability to assess higher-risk profiles, including PEPs and adverse media cases. Strong analytical, investigative, and reporting skills with excellent attention to detail.Confident communicator able to influence senior stakeholders and support operational teams.Proactive, organised, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Relevant professional qualifications (e.g., ICA) desirable.

Notes
Our client seeks a Head of Compliance to join their team. Role Profile: To lead the execution of Compliance Risk Management processes and activities to ensure that the area is undertaken in a compliant manner to avoid operational losses, fines, penalties or reputational damage to the organisation and enable the competitive advantage of the organisation. Key Responsibilities: Analyse the operational activities within the Branch to identify compliance risks and therefore ensure adherence to the relevant Group compliance frameworks and standards. Build and maintain effective relationships with the country regulators and stakeholders on all areas of responsibility. Develop, track and report on the progress of the compliance monitoring plans for the IOM Branch in order to identify significant compliance breaches, exposures and potential areas of improvement. Drive customisation and maintain generic risk management plans (RMPs) to ensure it is appropriate within the regulatory context of the specific country. Guide the adherence to the data model across the compliance team to ensure the collection, capturing and management of data adheres to the required data standards and policies. Key Skills and Experience: First Degree in Audit. First Degree in Legal. First Degree in Risk Management. 3 - 4 years experience in Business Enablement. Experience and a solid understanding of the relevant banking environment including the associated products and activities specific to area in which this role is responsible. 8-10 years experience - The role requires a seasoned expert in Compliance with a sound knowledge of the relevant regulatory requirements and upcoming developments applicable to a specific business area as well as a solid understanding of banking products and activities. To drive an effectively compliant function, an influential leader is required with a proven track record in leading a Functional team of Compliance resources. Technical Competencies: Evaluation of Internal Control. sFinancial Acumen. Financial Industry Regulatory Framework. Legal Compliance. Process Governance. Risk Awareness. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16614

Notes
Control Room Operator.

Manx Automobile Assistance – Isle of Man.
Stoney Mountain Road, Foxdale.

** Full-Time or Part-Time **

Manx Automobile Assistance is a trusted vehicle recovery and roadside assistance provider serving customers across the Isle of Man. We pride ourselves on delivering a professional, reliable, and customer-focused service 24 hours a day.

We are looking for a calm, organised, and proactive Control Room Operator to join our growing team. You will be the first point of contact for customers requiring roadside assistance and recovery services, ensuring that help is dispatched quickly, efficiently, and professionally.

The Role:

As a Control Room Operator, you will play a vital role in coordinating our roadside assistance and recovery operations. You will manage incoming calls, liaise with customers and recovery technicians, dispatch the appropriate resources, and monitor jobs through to completion.
This position requires excellent communication skills, strong decision-making abilities, and the confidence to remain calm under pressure while managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities:

Answer and manage incoming calls from customers requiring roadside assistance and vehicle recovery.
Coordinate and dispatch recovery operators and technicians to incidents across the Isle of Man.
Monitor the progress of active jobs and provide updates to customers where required.
Ensure accurate recording of all customer and job information.
Maintain detailed logs and operational records.
Communicate effectively with drivers, technicians, customers, and business partners.
Prioritise workload and respond quickly to changing situations.
Support the smooth day-to-day running of the control room.
Assist with general administration duties including filing, invoicing, and data entry.
Contribute to continuous improvements within the business and support new operational processes when required.

What We're Looking For -

Essential Skills & Qualities:
Excellent customer service and communication skills.
Ability to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations.
Strong organisational and multitasking abilities.
Good problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Competent computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
A proactive and flexible approach to work.

What We Offer:

Monday to Friday working pattern.
Competitive salary based on experience.
32 days holiday per year.
Full training provided.
Supportive and friendly working environment.
Opportunity to be part of a growing Isle of Man business with an excellent reputation.

To apply, please send your CV and a covering letter to – Timcole@manxaa.com
